about_the_game:
Blackjack Trainer: Initial Deal is a focused training DLC for Classic Blackjack — designed to sharpen your instincts on the most important part of the game: the opening decision.

Each round, you’ll see your two cards and the dealer’s up card. Choose Hit, Stand, Double, or Split, then instantly find out whether your move matched basic strategy.

There’s no betting, no full hands — just rapid-fire, decision-based practice that helps you master the first move of every round.

✅ Features

  • Learn the optimal play for every possible opening hand

  • Get instant feedback and see why a move is right or wrong

  • Train quickly with short, focused sessions

  • Uses the same rules and visuals from Classic Blackjack

  • Perfect for players looking to improve accuracy and confidence

💬 “There’s nothing like this out there.” — r/blackjack player feedback

This DLC is an add-on for Classic Blackjack and requires the base game to play.
